source.title: Breathing is coupled with voluntary action and the cortical readiness potential

confidence_rationale: Solid human EEG/behaviour study showing that SELF-INITIATED (but not externally cued) action onsets cluster in expiration -- respiration frames the timing of agent-initiated commitment, which is the closest human analogue of a breath-locked planning clock. But breathing here was spontaneous, not voluntarily controlled, so the paper evidences breath->action-timing coupling, not the claim's voluntary-handle leg; and its RP-modulation result was later shown to be an analysis confound (Jeay-Bizot 2026). Low mapping fidelity caps confidence.
failure_signatures: Coupling was measured under spontaneous breathing only; nothing in the design shows that deliberately altering breathing moves the timing of self-initiated action.

The readiness-potential modulation by respiratory phase reported here did not survive re-analysis controlling for movement-onset dependency (Jeay-Bizot et al. 2026, PLoS Biol), so only the behavioural onset clustering stands.
The measured event is action initiation (commitment), not plan abandonment or re-planning, which is what MECH-109 says the respiratory clock gates.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Participants initiate self-paced voluntary actions more often during expiration; this respiration-action coupling is absent for externally triggered actions; RP amplitude varies with respiratory phase.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the MECH-108/MECH-109 premise that the respiratory cycle is a clock for AGENT-INITIATED (endogenous) transitions in the action-selection pipeline, as opposed to stimulus-driven ones -- the respiratory phase biases when an internally generated plan is released into action.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Spontaneous not voluntary breathing; causal direction unresolved (preparing to act may lengthen expiration rather than expiration permitting action); measures commitment onset in a Libet task, not E3 plan-sweep abandonment; the exclusivity ('one handle') part of MECH-109 is not addressed.
mapping.source_context: Healthy adult humans; scalp EEG + respiration; Libet-style self-paced button press vs externally cued press. Park et al. 2022 (NeuroImage, PMID 36252914) extend the onset coupling to self-initiated motor and visual IMAGERY, i.e. covert mental actions.

confidence_components.notes: Nature Communications, replicated behavioural effect (Park 2022; Jeay-Bizot 2026; Sandoval 2026). Mapping fidelity low because the voluntary-control and plan-abandonment components are both absent.
